decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that is close to the core water-infrastructure offer, management is likely to continue backing it because development and market-entry costs are already sunk and any weak early uptake can still be framed as normal adoption delay in municipal projects.

This product directly matches the firm's announced move toward digitally networked, efficient and energy-aware infrastructure, so public strategic commitment and prior R&D investment strongly favor keeping it on the market.

Because it was launched as a multi-model product line and given its own website page, the firm has made a visible commercial commitment and is therefore likely to persist unless results turn clearly and persistently negative.
